title.rendered: Top 10 British Curriculum Schools In Sharjah: 2025 Reviews

content.rendered:
Sharjah, a thriving educational hub in the UAE, is home to a wide array of outstanding schools that offer the esteemed British curriculum. For parents seeking quality education rooted in UK standards, Sharjah presents a blend of tradition, innovation, and academic excellence.

In this comprehensive guide, we spotlight 10 of the most distinguished British curriculum schools in Sharjah, each celebrated for delivering exceptional teaching practices, holistic student development, and inclusive, values-driven learning environments.

Selecting the ideal school is a pivotal decision, but academic support outside the classroom can further empower students to reach their full potential.

That’s where Ignite Training Institute makes a difference. With a strong focus on the British curriculum, Ignite offers support with expert IGCSE tutors and A-Level tutors who provide personalized academic guidance, helping students build confidence and achieve remarkable success.

Top 10 British Curriculum Schools In Sharjah

Discover the finest British Curriculum schools in Sharjah, offering a world-class education and nurturing young minds for a bright future. Here are the top 10 schools that stand out for their academic excellence and holistic development programs

1. Sharjah English School (SES)

Sharjah English School (SES) is a not‑for‑profit British‑curriculum school founded in 1974. Nestled on a sprawling campus opposite Sharjah University City, it serves students aged 3 to 19 (Foundation Stage through A‑Level), offering a caring, community‑driven educational experience 

SES prides itself on its inclusive atmosphere supported by UK‑trained teachers. With intentional, gradual growth, the school maintains a small‑scale environment where each student is personally known and nurtured 

The green, expansive campus, one of the largest in the UAE, boasts outstanding facilities: a sports hall, swimming pool, extensive playing fields, auditorium, ICT suites, library, music and drama studios, and a dedicated Acorn Building for kindergarten and infants.

Academically, SES follows the British National Curriculum, offering EYFS through IGCSE and A‑Levels. It’s accredited by British Schools Overseas (rated Outstanding), BSME, COBIS, and overseen by the Sharjah Private Education Authority. The school is celebrated for consistently strong GCSE and A‑Level outcomes, with students advancing to top universities worldwide.

A wide variety of extracurricular and enrichment opportunities, from sports and creative arts to service learning, leadership trips, Duke of Edinburgh Award, and international expeditions, are woven into the school’s ethos, encouraging students to explore diverse interests and grow holistically.

SES’s founding heritage, intimate setting, diverse student body, and reputation for excellence combine to make it one of the most esteemed British schools in the region. Families are encouraged to tour the campus to truly appreciate its atmosphere and community feel 

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, GCSE, IGCSE
  • Annual Fees: AED 28,420 – AED 72,765
  • SPEA Rating: Very Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS 1 to Grade 13
  • Address: Meliha Rd, Opposite University City, Sharjah, UAE

2. Wesgreen International School

Wesgreen International School, established in Sharjah in 1991, has built a reputation for delivering excellence in education with a British-based curriculum accredited by the Council of International Schools. The school spans four distinct campuses, Early Years, Primary, Girls’ Secondary, and Boys’ Secondary, providing tailored learning environments from Foundation Stage through Year 13.

The academic journey at Wesgreen begins with a fusion of EYFS, the British National Curriculum, and Cambridge Primary in the early years and primary phase. As students progress to secondary levels, they enter the Cambridge pathway, culminating in IGCSEs, AS, and A‑Levels, complemented by essential subjects such as Arabic, Islamic Studies, and Moral Education.

Wesgreen embraces multicultural inclusivity, hosting over 4,000 students from 68 different nationalities, alongside a global staff representing more than 40 countries. This diversity enriches the learning environment, further enhanced by its state-of-the-art facilities, computer and science labs, libraries (including e-libraries), multimedia halls, art rooms, gymnasiums, sports fields, and even a swimming pool in the Primary section.

Wesgreen is also a pioneer in environmental and student well-being initiatives, introducing Sharjah’s first forest school and school farm, where students engage in nature-based learning, sustainable practices, and hands-on stewardship of animals and plants. Recent campus enhancements include a dedicated sixth-form area and advanced STEM labs to bolster innovation and academic rigor.

Supported by strong accreditations (CIS, BSO, AoBSO, among others) and a clear vision to be the UAE’s premier school of choice, Wesgreen prioritizes holistic development, nurturing students academically, morally, socially, and physically for global citizenship.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, IGCSE, UK EYFS  
  • Annual Fees: AED 19,000 – AED 47,465  
  • SPEA Rating: Good  
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS 1 to Year 13  
  • Address: Al Muweilah Commercial, Sharjah, UAE 

3. International School of Creative Science – Muwaileh

Founded in 2002, the International School of Creative Science – Muwaileh (ISCS Muwaileh) delivers a robust education by blending the UK National Curriculum with the UAE Ministry of Education’s curriculum in Arabic, Islamic Studies, Social Studies, and Moral Education. This dual approach reflects a commitment to both academic excellence and cultural values, enhanced by a standout Qur’an memorisation programme.

The school is celebrated for its “Distinguished School in UAE” and “Distinguished Teacher in Sharjah” awards from the Sharjah Award for Excellence in Education, showcasing its high standards.

ISCS serves a diverse and vibrant community of over 4,450 students and 500 staff from more than 68 nationalities, supported by 85 quality teachers and enriched by a range of more than 25 extra‑curricular activities.

The campus features state-of-the-art facilities: interactive classrooms with whiteboards and computers, well-resourced libraries, ICT and science labs, innovation kitchen labs, multi-purpose halls, indoor and outdoor playgrounds, gymnasiums, swimming pools, and an auditorium for performances and events.

Academically, ISCS Muwaileh consistently achieves outstanding IGCSE and A‑Level results, including top scores within the UAE and Middle East in subjects such as Chemistry, Physics, Further Mathematics, and Arabic. 

Students have earned accolades in the Pearson Learner Awards and excel in competitions like the Arab Reading Challenge, national science expos, coding, Quran recitation, and even sports like basketball, reflecting both intellectual and personal development.

The school’s ethos emphasizes innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership, and digital literacy, through initiatives like Bring‑Your‑Own‑Device (BYOD), digital learning integration, student councils, and business-themed days that foster real-world skills.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British  
  • Annual Fees: AED 22,240 – AED 43,390  
  • SPEA Rating: Good  
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS1 to Year 13  
  • Address: Industrial Area, Muwailih Commercial, Sharjah, UAE  

4. Scholars International Academy

Scholars International Academy (SIA), founded in 2007 and located near Sharjah University City, delivers a robust British-style education rooted in the UK’s National Curriculum, enriched with Cambridge programs. As one of only two schools in Sharjah accredited by British Schools Overseas (BSO) and a member of British Schools of the Middle East (BSME), SIA adheres to high international standards.

The school serves learners from FS‑1 to Year 13, emphasizing a student-centered, holistic learning environment that nurtures “whole” child development through global pedagogies and multiple intelligences. Its educational philosophy centers on empowering students as authors of their learning journey, equipping them with critical thinking, communication, and cultural awareness skills.

At the heart of SIA’s approach lies High Performance Learning (HPL), a framework that fosters advanced cognitive performance, values, attitudes, and attributes in each learner. The result is a classroom environment where students are taught how to think, not just what to think.

SIA boasts strong academic outcomes: students consistently achieve top IGCSE and A‑Level results, with many earning A* and A grades. The well-rounded curriculum is balanced with leadership opportunities, internships, extracurriculars like sports, arts, and cultural programs, and a supportive inclusion system.

Supported by a modern campus designed for engagement, SIA offers facilities such as ICT labs, libraries, semi‑Olympic swimming pools, sports courts, arts and drama studios, design and technology rooms, and more. The school embraces diversity with a vibrant community of learners from over 60 nationalities.

SIA also extends into post‑16 learning, delivering A‑Levels and BTEC options within a university-style environment featuring small classes, leadership programs, and even scholarships for academic merit and initiative.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British  
  • Annual Fees: AED 23,500 – AED 36,000  
  • SPEA Rating: Good  
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS 1 to Year 13  
  • Address: Near Sharjah University City, Sharjah, UAE  

5. Brilliant International Private School

Brilliant International Private School (BIPS), established in 2011, has grown from just 60 students at its inception to over 800 within three years, reflecting its strong reputation in Sharjah’s education landscape. BIPS delivers a British curriculum enriched with IGCSE and UK EYFS frameworks that focus on holistic learning, digital integration, and student-centered instruction.

The school’s philosophy is rooted in developing not only academic excellence but also creativity, critical thinking, and personal values. Its early years benefit from modern, interactive learning spaces and dynamic co-curricular offerings, such as swimming lessons and clubs, that engage learners across age groups.

Under the leadership of Principal Asifa Sultana, BIPS commits to nurturing lifelong learners who are resilient, adaptable, and prepared to navigate complex challenges. The school consistently delivers strong academic performance, boasting that 95% of IGCSE, 76% of AS Level, and 75% of A Level results fall within the A*–C range. 

Their modern facilities include well-equipped science and ICT labs, a library, art and music studios, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, sports grounds, a multipurpose hall, a health clinic, and a cafeteria, all designed to support a balanced and enriching school experience.

BIPS stands out for its inclusive, value-driven environment, emphasizing innovation, tolerance, and global citizenship.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, IGCSE, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 14,560 – 28,600
  • SPEA Rating: Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS to Year 13
  • Address: Muwilah (School Area), Near National Paints – Sharjah, UAE

6. GEMS Cambridge International Private School – Sharjah

GEMS Cambridge International Private School – Sharjah offers a British-style education based on the National Curriculum for England, tailored to prepare students for future academic and professional success. The school caters to learners from FS1 through Year 13 and emphasizes not only strong academic standards but also a commitment to developing confident, independent thinkers.

A wide range of enrichment opportunities helps students grow beyond the classroom. The school encourages design thinking and values-led learning, aiming to build self-awareness, confidence, and competence in every learner.

GEMS Cambridge has earned several prestigious accreditations, including British Schools Overseas, COBIS, Cambridge International Examinations, Pearson/Edexcel, and membership in CIS, among others. The school is also a Microsoft Showcase School, and it has received awards for wellbeing, parental partnership, and environmental sustainability.

The campus provides modern, purpose-built facilities designed to support a rich learning environment. Students benefit from advanced science and STEAM labs, robotics-equipped ICT spaces, art and music rooms, libraries, a multipurpose hall, sports areas, prayer rooms, a cafeteria, clinic, and a parent café.

In its inaugural SPEA review, the school achieved a “Very Good” rating, recognized for its educational excellence, holistic development, and strong Arabic language proficiency.

The school also places a strong emphasis on sustainability and student-driven environmental initiatives. Its Sustainability Club leads hands-on projects aligned with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals, fostering leadership, social responsibility, and environmental consciousness among students.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, GCSE, IGCSE, NCfE, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 20,000 – 30,000
  • SPEA Rating: Very Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS1 to Year 13
  • Address: Muwailih School Zone – Sharjah, UAE

7. Providence English Private School

Providence English Private School (PEPS), established in 1991 and fully operational since 1999, is a British curriculum co-educational school located in the School Compound of Mowaileh Commercial, Sharjah. The school is accredited by the Ministry of Education, recognized by the Council of International Schools (CIS), and serves as an accredited Cambridge Examination Centre.

The campus spans approximately 320,000 sq ft across two purpose-built buildings: one houses KG1 through Grade 3 and the other spans Grades 4 to 12. Facilities include spacious classrooms equipped with cameras, computers, projectors, and internet access, two science labs, two libraries, two computer labs, three activity rooms, a conference hall for IGCSE exams, two school clinics, administrative and finance offices, and two canteen halls. The property also has six outdoor playgrounds and six indoor play areas.

The school emphasizes a caring, socially responsible environment aimed at nurturing well-rounded students with strong moral, academic, and social foundations. Its mission includes fostering global citizens, encouraging leadership, spiritual, physical and academic growth, and helping students realize their full potential. The school integrates technology into learning and promotes respect, personal growth, and long-term academic aspirations.

Providence English Private School offers a rich program of extracurricular and student development activities. Students participate in educational trips, inter-school events, sports, arts, clubs, competitions, and community initiatives. It also has a Digital Citizenship Program promoting responsible and safe use of technology.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, IGCSE, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 13,520 – 27,800
  • SPEA Rating: Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS1 to Year 13
  • Address: Sharjah, School Compound, Mowaileh Area – Sharjah, UAE

8. Al Ansar International School

Al Ansar International School, established in 2001 in Sharjah, offers a spacious, ultra-modern campus designed to nurture academic growth within a supportive Islamic environment. The school delivers the UK National Curriculum from FS1 to Year 9, followed by IGCSE, AS, and A-Level programs, across Cambridge, Edexcel, and Oxford AQA examination boards. 

It is fully licensed by both the UAE Ministry of Education and the Sharjah Private Education Authority and holds accreditations for these prestigious examination bodies.

The educational approach combines 21st-century learning skills, AI-enhanced e-learning platforms, and interactive teaching methods, tailored to produce globally-minded, ethically grounded graduates. Its mission emphasizes academic excellence, moral values, community engagement, and partnership with parents in fostering lifelong, responsible learners.

Facilities include state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor sports amenities, such as AstroTurf football fields, a 300-meter synthetic running track, adventure play areas, multiple activity rooms, and air-conditioned auditoriums. The school also supports student mobility through well-managed transportation services, ensuring safety and convenience for families.

The school community frequently praises Al Ansar for its balanced focus on strong academics and a nurturing, Islamic ethos. Parents and students highlight advanced teaching, caring staff, and meaningful emphasis on character development.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, IGCSE, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 14,900 – 28,200
  • SPEA Rating: Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS1 to Year 13
  • Address: Street-7, Al Qarayen-3 – Sharjah, UAE

9. PACE British School

PACE British School, founded in 2019 and located in Muweilah, Sharjah, delivers the prestigious Cambridge International Curriculum, rooted in the English National Curriculum and culminating in IGCSE and A-Level qualifications. Its learning approach is thoughtfully structured to be flexible, challenging, and culturally sensitive, fostering curiosity, confidence, and a passion for sustained learning. 

The school’s vision is to become the foremost affordable British curriculum institution in Sharjah, offering engaging, stimulating, and relevant learning experiences while promoting internationalism, tolerance, and kindness. Its mission includes maintaining the highest academic standards, nurturing mental health, and supporting a well-rounded, balanced lifestyle for all students. 

PACE goes beyond academics to build critical thinking, problem-solving, and digital literacy skills. It encourages students to become independent thinkers and innovators through research, debate, and digital exploration.

The school community is notably diverse and inclusive, offering a welcoming environment where every student is valued. This multicultural setting enriches learning and fosters global citizenship.

State-of-the-art facilities enhance the educational experience at PACE. These include interactive classrooms, well-equipped science and STEAM labs, robotics and computer labs, a fully equipped library, an auditorium, and extensive sports facilities. The school also provides safe and comfortable transportation across Sharjah, Ajman, and Dubai.

The school’s ethos encourages students to go beyond textbooks through initiatives including physical and mental fitness, community involvement, etiquette grooming, life skills development, parental engagement, and academic rigor ❝Our school ethos encourages a welcoming, happy, and positive learning community in which everyone is encouraged to think beyond textbooks…❞.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, IGCSE, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 16,500 – 28,000
  • SPEA Rating: Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: FS1 to Year 13
  • Address: School Zone, Muweilah – Sharjah, UAE

10. Al Murooj English School

Al Murooj English School, established in 1994, resides in the Al Azra area of Sharjah and delivers the British National Curriculum with a focus on early years and primary education (from KG1 to Grade 6). It prioritizes nurturing close student‑teacher relationships within a caring and supportive learning environment, aiming to foster academic excellence together with emotional and creative development.

The school encourages interactive and experiential learning through group projects, arts and crafts, technology-enhanced classrooms, and critical thinking exercises. A notable pedagogical strength is its emphasis on individualized attention, where lessons are designed to be dynamic and student-centric, rather than teacher-dominated monologues.

Al Murooj is recognized with a Good rating by the Sharjah Private Education Authority (SPEA). It maintains solid accreditations and applies structured assessments based on Early Learning Goals to ensure each child’s progress is accurately monitored.

Key Information at a glance:

  • Curriculum: British, UK EYFS
  • Annual Fees: AED 11,100 – 14,100
  • SPEA Rating: Good
  • Grades or Year Groups: KG 1 to Grade 6
  • Address: Al Azra – Sharjah, UAE

Related: Top 10 Leading British Curriculum Schools In Abu Dhabi

FAQs

1. What Is The British Curriculum In UAE?

The British curriculum in the UAE follows the framework of UK schools, providing students with a comprehensive and globally recognized education of high quality. It offers a well-rounded learning experience to students in the UAE.

2. How Much Are British School Fees In Sharjah?

British curriculum schools in Sharjah charge fees that are influenced by factors like school reputation, facilities, and grade level. On average, annual fees can range from AED 20,000 to AED 60,000 or higher.

3. Which Curriculum Is Best In UAE? 

The British curriculum, based on the UK’s educational framework, is known for its academic rigor, emphasis on critical thinking, and well-rounded education.

4. What Curriculum Do Top British Schools In Sharjah Follow?

Top British schools in Sharjah typically follow the National Curriculum of England, offering qualifications such as IGCSEs and A-Levels. Some also integrate Cambridge or Edexcel frameworks for international recognition.

5. What Are The Typical School Fees For British Schools In Sharjah?

School fees for British curriculum schools in Sharjah generally range from AED 15,000 to AED 75,000 per year. The exact cost varies depending on the grade level, facilities, and reputation of the school.

Conclusion 

In conclusion, British curriculum schools in Sharjah offer a comprehensive and internationally recognized education. With a focus on academic excellence, holistic development, and fostering critical thinking, these schools provide students with a well-rounded learning experience. Families seeking quality education in Sharjah can find a diverse range of British curriculum schools, each catering to the unique needs and aspirations of their students.
